format: Swan Academy design specification v1.2 (plain JSON; not a Figma import schema)

fonts.serif: "Playfair Display Variable", "Playfair Display", ui-serif, Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
fonts.italic: Use the real Playfair Display italic font file, not a simulated slant.

breakpoints.note: Phone-specific header/forms below 640; compact Founder/System/Rooms and single-column application/checkout below 1024.

header.phonePaint: Use the ::before recipe in source-snapshot/src/styles.css. It differs from desktop and extends above the viewport.
header.statusBarBoundary: Physical Safari status-bar extension was unsuccessful; full extension remains unresolved. Do not promise full-screen glass continuation.

floatingCTA.heroAndOfferRelease: .8 of each button height passes header bottom
floatingCTA.hideOnContact: first section button top <= resting banner bottom + 1px
floatingCTA.finalRule: Remain hidden after final CTA and through footer; reverse behavior when scrolling upward.

topFade.note: Add safe-area-top to the 48–128px stops. Background overlay, not a blur filter; no particles.

motion.founderMobile: Zero-height position:sticky tip at 50dvh; upward 100vh pseudo-element clipped by rail overflow:clip. Subtract contained scrollport top padding on iOS. Same geometry with reduced motion; direct JS fallback when unsupported. No sampled scroll timeline or time-based settling.
motion.founderDesktop: Zero-height position:sticky tip at 50dvh; upward 100vh pseudo-element clipped by rail overflow:clip. Subtract contained scrollport top padding on iOS. Same geometry with reduced motion; direct JS fallback when unsupported. No sampled scroll timeline or time-based settling.
motion.reducedMotion: Disable nonessential animation; direct progress tracking; instant banner state.

status.mobileGrid: 2 columns; 24px gap; groups centered, content left-aligned

checkout.summaryMonogram: 32px square; upper-right; center aligned to Your enrollment
checkout.priceStatus: US$350 is an illustrative one-time preview, not final pricing.
